reddit.question: What’s a good iPhone teleprompter setup for recording videos?
reddit.reply: Try placing the script close to the camera lens so your gaze stays near the audience. A simple phone teleprompter can make that easier; look for one with a pace that suits how you speak.

reddit.question: Any tips for presenting without losing my place in a script?
reddit.reply: Break the script into short sections, add pause cues where you need a beat, and rehearse with the text near eye level. That can make it easier to pick up again if you lose your place.

reddit.question: Is there a teleprompter app that pauses when I stop talking?
reddit.reply: Some teleprompters offer voice-paced scrolling, which pauses when you stop and resumes when you speak. Check whether that feature is included or an optional paid extra.
